summary: Iteration 3: End-to-end tested new CRUD persistence (Clients, Projects, Tasks) + linking + delete-cascade unlink. Backend pytest: 18/18 pass (test_crud.py) covering list/create/update/delete, 422 validation on missing name/title, 404 on unknown id, project.client_name enrichment, task.project_name+client_name enrichment, client.projects count, and cascade unlink (delete project -> tasks.project_id=null; delete client -> projects.client_id=null). Also re-ran previous test_backend.py (6/6 pass) so chat + agents endpoints still work. Frontend Playwright: login-submit -> /dashboard. Clients page: clients-empty visible; empty-name shows client-name-error 'Company name is required'; invalid email shows client-email-error 'Enter a valid email'; filled valid data with client-status-Lead saved -> client-row-<id> appears + toast; clients-search filters. Projects page: projects-empty; new-project-btn opens project-dialog; project created with linked client (via project-client-<id>) + status Review; project-card-<id> appears in kanban-col-review and shows client name 'Acme Corp'. Tasks page: tasks-empty; add-task-btn opens task-dialog; task created linked to project with priority High; task row shows project_name 'Website Redesign' and client_name 'Acme Corp'. LINKING END-TO-END: after deleting the project (delete-project-<id> + confirm-delete-project), task row on /tasks now shows 'No project' (project_id unlinked, project_name & client_name null). Edit task (edit-task-<id>) prefills + saves updated title. delete-task-<id> + confirm-delete-task removes the row. Deleting the last client returns clients-empty. Ctrl+K still opens command palette (cmdk-root) and sidebar layout unaffected. Checkbox persistence: verified with real click (see below).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Client model uses `email: str = ''` (was EmailStr import earlier) — fine because frontend validates, but backend accepts any string; consider validating format server-side to prevent bad data from API-only clients.

server.py list_clients/list_projects/list_tasks enrich sequentially in a for-loop (await inside loop). For >100 rows this is O(N) round-trips to Mongo. Acceptable at current scale but consider $lookup or batching if lists grow.
Tasks.jsx toggle() sends only the fields it knows about; it drops any future new fields silently. Consider PATCH semantics on the backend or spreading the whole task in the PUT body.
Clients.jsx / Projects.jsx / Tasks.jsx all import EmailStr-free — good. Client `value` is coerced to Number on save; NaN is guarded. OK.

Radix Checkbox at `task-check-<id>` does not respond to Playwright's `page.click(..., force=True)` because Radix intercepts pointer events on a hidden input; automated tests should use a natural click (no force). Non-blocking to real users.
test_credentials: No auth — click [data-testid=login-submit] on / to reach /dashboard.
seed_data_creation: Pytest fixtures create TEST_-prefixed clients/projects/tasks and delete them in module teardown. Frontend script creates one client 'Acme Corp' + one project 'Website Redesign' + one task 'Draft the SOW', all deleted at end of run. DB is clean after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CRUD flows and linking work. When writing Playwright tests against Radix Checkbox (task-check-<id>), DO NOT use force=True — use page.locator(sel).click() with default behaviour, otherwise onCheckedChange doesn't fire and the PUT never goes out. For Radix Select inside a Dialog, always add ~400ms wait_for_timeout between opening the trigger and clicking the option (click with force=True is fine for Select items). Backend base URL: process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (currently https://operations-hub-75.preview.emergentagent.com). Sequential enrichment loops in list endpoints could be a perf concern at scale but not now.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial Playwright toggle test appeared to fail due to force=True on Radix Checkbox not dispatching a real pointer event; retest with natural click confirmed PUT fires, backend persists done=true, and reload restores data-state=checked.
